items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: A fellow pulled on there, his name was Poissy Wright. Poissy Wright from New Orleans. ... Poissy, what are you doing coming out the depot? ... He said, I'll tell you what I'm doing. I'm going, we're going to make a trip all the way to El Paso tonight at 1130. And when you get over there, I connect y

ctx.x: But in fact, we planted money there and away with everyone. The place was packed like sardines.

The Dreamland right around the corner. Big store called Billings, Dreamland. We played, packed like sardines. We played, played. Money come on a Saturday night, they raid the place. They put everybody in jail, but they look at the band. They want to put us in jail, but the champions say, oh no, we didn't party. They didn't lock you up that time then? No. All right. Well, that was really bad, didn't they? That was going out of the field then. Going out of the field. All right. Well, got in the field. Well, they…

He just died about a month ago, Ed Garland told us. Poissy Wright died? Wasn't it? Wasn't he the one? I don't know where he is. No, that was the bouncer. The bouncer died. Who was the big chaper? Oh, you're talking about Zach Williams. Zach Williams died about a month ago.

items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: So I plays there with him until about eleven o'clock. ... And I plays there with him in the girls' place.

ctx.x: I'll go and test them out. That's all right. Let's be starting a visit. Don't worry about it.

So, after grand opening that night, so what I does, Poison says, I go to the airport and meet him at seven o'clock. He says, well we got a lot of time. I says, let's go around. I say, your band is open for the Dream Line. I say, yeah. I say, let's go around. We went around and there's a packing jam. I think on Big Zack Show, the Bremier of the Bandstand. It was so packed. He was sticking with us. He said, get out the way. They all get out the way. He said, just say, please. Same band, we left with him just like…
years ago. What year was that? Four years was the hanging room.
